name: Hotel Hermitage
positioning: Hotel Hermitage Monte-Carlo: a Belle Epoque hotel on Square Beaumarchais in Monaco, overlooking the sea and the Rock, with Yannick Alleno restaurants and access to the Thermes Marins Monte-Carlo
best_for: Travelers who want Belle Epoque architecture and sea views in central Monaco
Food lovers interested in Yannick Alleno's restaurants
Couples looking at Diamond Suites with terraces

facts.text: The hotel is on Square Beaumarchais in Monaco.
The hotel overlooks the sea and the Rock.
The hotel has three restaurants: Pavyllon Monte-Carlo and L'Abysse Monte-Carlo, both by Yannick Alleno, and Le Limun.
L'Abysse Monte-Carlo is a Japanese restaurant.
Hotel guests have access to the Thermes Marins Monte-Carlo wellness centre, with an indoor pool, solarium, sauna, steam room, jacuzzi and fitness room.
Stays include access to the private Monte-Carlo Beach Club, with its Olympic-sized pool and beach, in season.
Guests get free access to the Casino de Monte-Carlo.
A private shuttle takes guests around the Monte-Carlo Societe des Bains de Mer Resort.
The Kids Room is exclusively for hotel guests during all school holidays except February, subject to conditions.
The hotel bar has a terrace, open in season.
The square seen from the city-view Junior Suites is named after the author of The Barber of Seville and The Marriage of Figaro.
Nice-Monaco transfers by helicopter, taxi or door-to-door car are available at an extra charge.

highlights.text: The hotel has Belle Epoque architecture, and an Eiffel dome is the signature feature of its Winter Garden.
Marcel Pagnol stayed several times in the rooms that are now the Diamond Suite Pagnol, which includes a large terrace.
The new sea-view Diamond Suites were designed by Pierre-Yves Rochon, with Versailles parquet flooring, Calacatta marble and mosaic floors.
The Diamond Suite sea view with jacuzzi has a terrace with a private jacuzzi and a view of the old city and the Prince's Palace.
Gustave, the hotel bar, was conceived by interior architect Shirine Zirak in the spirit of a contemporary salon and serves creative cocktails.

considerations.text: Access to the Monte-Carlo Beach Club, with its pool and beach, is in season only.
Parking is paid, at 55 euros per day.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the exclusive Monte Carlo location.
